messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: specify breaks for each panel
parts:
Hoping this message gets associated with the previous thread "specify
breaks for each panel"...

One thing that might also reasonably be associated with facet_grid()
is the breaks supplied to stat_summary when building histograms. I
encountered a case recently where I wanted two side-by-side histograms
of data with very different ranges, which is achived via a "scales =
'free_x'" argument to facet_grid. However, I wanted to specify the
breaks for each histogram manually (because I wanted a bin with a
midpoint equal to zero), and this doesn't seem possible with the
current design.

Mike

--
Mike Lawrence
Graduate Student
Department of Psychology
Dalhousie University

messages.subject: Re: specify breaks for each panel
parts:
Along the same lines, being able to specify the parameters to any stat
independently for each panel would be good. For example, I tried
density plots of the data to which I referred in my last email and in
one, but only one, of the panels the kernel is clearly too small.
